object.attr: stakeholder: undoing would overwrite another window's, an agent's or draw.io's change without a word. The test case changes a file in another document, and rewrites a file to the same size within 2 s (failure F9). Merged with the GUI author's requirement.
object.description: If a file of an undo step changed after the step was made or undone, the Document Editor shall refuse to undo or redo the step and tell the user why.
